All-in-one washer-dryer combos have evolved significantly with the introduction of heat pump technology, which allows them to wash and dry a full load in about two hours using a standard 120V outlet.

Top Recommended Models

These units are ideal for saving space and eliminating the need for external venting.

  • The GE Profile UltraFast Combo is widely considered the best overall. It features a 4.8 cu. ft. capacity and a unique Pet Hair Removal cycle. Its 32-inch depth makes it the easiest full-size combo to fit into tight closet installs.

  • The Samsung Bespoke AI Laundry Combo offers the largest capacity at 5.3 cu. ft. It stands out for its 7" AI Home LCD touchscreen and the fastest "Super Speed" cycle, which can wash and dry a small load in just 98 minutes.

  • The LG WashCombo All-in-One is praised for its smooth daily performance and efficient lint filtration system. It is often cited as the best "daily driver" for typical clothing and towel loads.

turns.prompt_text: what do people say about these washer dryer combos are they better than having individual washer dryers
turns.response_html:
Modern all-in-one washer-dryer combos have gained a lot of popularity recently due to new heat pump technology, but they serve a very different lifestyle than traditional separate units.

Here is a breakdown of what users and experts say regarding how they compare:

Why People Prefer All-In-One Combos

  • Ultimate Convenience: The biggest "pro" cited by users is the "set it and forget it" workflow. You put dirty clothes in and take dry clothes out without having to move heavy, wet laundry between machines.
  • Flexible Installation: Most new models (like the GE Profile UltraFast) are ventless and run on a standard 120V outlet. This means you can put them in a closet, bathroom, or kitchen without needing a 240V hookup or a hole in your wall for a dryer vent.
  • Space Saving: They effectively halve the footprint of your laundry setup, which is a "game changer" for those in apartments or smaller homes.

Why People Stick to Individual Units

  • Speed & Throughput: In a separate set, you can wash a second load while the first is drying. With a combo, the machine is occupied for the entire 2–3 hour cycle, meaning you can't start a new wash until the previous load is completely dry.
  • Drying Performance: While heat pump combos are much better than older versions, some users still report that clothes feel slightly damp or "steamy" immediately after a cycle compared to the crisp, bone-dry feel of a traditional vented dryer.
  • Maintenance: Combos require diligent lint filter cleaning after every single load. If lint builds up inside the internal heat exchanger, drying times can double or triple over time.

Which Should You Choose?

  • Choose a Combo if: You live alone or with one other person, have limited space, or find the "laundry switch" to be a major chore you often forget.
  • Choose Separate Units if: You have a large family, do multiple loads of laundry back-to-back on weekends, or have the space and hookups for a traditional vented setup.

Top-Rated Combo Options

The GE Profile PFQ97HSPVDS is currently a top recommendation because it handles bulky bedding better than most other combos and fits into a standard 32-inch deep closet.

The Samsung Bespoke AI Laundry Combo is praised for its massive 5.3 cu. ft. capacity and its "Super Speed" setting that can finish a small load in under 100 minutes.

The LG WashCombo All-in-One is often cited as the most reliable "daily driver" for families, with a very effective Inverter HeatPump that keeps energy costs low.
